channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Medienkunstpreis 2027 der Kunststiftung Ingvild und Stephan Goetz (AdBK München) (closes 20 Nov)
item.description:
Kunststiftung Ingvild und Stephan Goetz, Sammlung Goetz and Akademie der Bildenden Künste München
Deadline: 20 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 5,000 production budget, plus an exhibition at the AkademieGalerie; the work enters the Goetz collection. No application fee.

A production prize for a new, unrealised film, video or media installation, open only to AdBK München final-year students (graduating within six months) and graduates up to two years out. The winning work is shown at the AkademieGalerie and acquired for the Sammlung Goetz.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Leiden Shorts 2027: International and National Competition Submissions (closes 11 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Leiden Shorts International Film Festival
Deadline: 11 Jan 2027
Award: Jury financial award (amount not stated) and an Audience Award. Fees EUR 15.50 regular / EUR 22 last chance (Brand New Eyes debut and student strand EUR 12.50 / 19).

Leiden Shorts takes short films up to 30 minutes completed after 1 January 2026, in all genres including animation, for its International and National Competitions and the Brand New Eyes strand for debuts and student films. Works in progress are accepted if finished before April 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ortung 15: Schwabach Art Prize 2027 (site-specific biennale, prizes up to EUR 6,000) (closes 11 Jan 2027)
item.description:
City of Schwabach, Kulturamt
Deadline: 11 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 1,000 expenses per selected artist; jury prizes EUR 6,000 and EUR 3,000; audience prizes EUR 3,000, 2,000 and 1,000.

ortung is a site-specific art biennale in which works transform spaces in Schwabach's town centre; the 15th edition's theme is Inspired by gold. Installation, video and computer artists are explicitly included. ELIGIBILITY: open to individuals, collectives and organisations.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Vienna Shorts 2027: Film Submissions (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Vienna Shorts
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: About EUR 30,000 in awards (EUR 1,500 to 6,000 per competition); screening fees paid for non-competitive selections. Fees: Animation Avantgarde EUR 13, Fiction and Documentary EUR 19, non-competitive EUR 10, Austrian entries EUR 5 (plus EUR 10 in the late window).

Vienna Shorts, an Oscar-, BAFTA- and European Film Awards-qualifying short film festival, takes films up to 30 minutes completed after 1 January 2026, including the international Animation Avantgarde competition for animation and experimental film.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Zinegoak 2027 Official Section (Bilbao LGTBIQA+ film festival; prizes up to EUR 4,000) (closes 28 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Zinegoak, Bilbao International LGTBIQA+ Film and Performing Arts Festival
Deadline: 28 Feb 2027
Award: Grand Prix best feature EUR 4,000; Diversity and Human Rights Award EUR 3,000; Lesbianism and Gender Award EUR 3,000; Audience Award best short EUR 1,000. Prizes are taxed and split 50/50 with a Spanish distributor where one exists. No entry fee stated.

Zinegoak's official section screens features and shorts on sexual and gender diversity in the FIK, DOK and KRAK sections (over 45 minutes) and a shorts section (under 45 minutes).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: BBBank Award in Projection Mapping 2027: PLAYGROUND (ZKM, SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe) (closes 25 Nov)
item.description:
ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe, with BBBank and SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe
Deadline: 25 Nov 2026, 13:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 prize if the selected concept is realised, plus EUR 10,000 production funding covering fees and technology. No application fee.

Open call for a 7-minute projection mapping on the Karlsruhe palace facade, on the 2027 festival theme Playground (The Art of Playing). For artists, designers, studios and collectives working in projection mapping; ZKM provides curatorial and technical coaching.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen: Call for Films, 73rd Festival (2027)
item.description: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen (International Short Film Festival Oberhausen) · deadline 18 Jan 2027 · International Competition: Grand Prize of the City of Oberhausen EUR 8,000, Principal Prize EUR 4,000, Promotional Prize EUR 1,500, plus a European Film Awards short film nomination. German Competition: EUR 5,000 main prize, EUR 1,500 promotional, EUR 2,500 3sat Emerging Talent Prize (with purchase offer), EUR 1,000 ZONTA Prize for a female filmmaker. NRW Competition: EUR 1,000 and EUR 500 prizes, plus NRW Ministry prizes of EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, FIPRESCI Prize, EUR 2,000 Ecumenical Jury Prize, EUR 750 WDR Westart Audience Jury Prize. Children's and Youth: several EUR 1,000-1,500 prizes and an ECFA Short Film Award nomination. Prizes go to the directors. SUBMISSION FEE: first five submissions per submitter are free; EUR 20 handling fee per film from the sixth.

item.title: AFTER THE PALACE: Resonance 2026 Video Mapping Contest (Krakow)
item.description: University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (unLoc project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Cash prizes: PLN 10,000 (~EUR 2,340) first place, PLN 6,000 second, PLN 3,000 third; the jury may award additional honorary distinctions or redistribute the pool. Free to enter, submission is exclusively digital.
